title: BIT RESCUE (DIGITAL CRISIS CHALLENGE)
rules:
1. The participant will be given a maximum of five minutes and minimum of three minutes to perform their stand up act. Exceeding the time limit will lead to disqualification.
  2. The stand up act will be followed by a Q&A (Question and Answer) where the participant has to answer two questions asked by the judges on their respective topic.
  3. The topics will be allotted at the time of filling the registration form, once allotted the topic is prohibited to change.
  4. In the Q&A section two questions will be asked to the participant which should be answered on the spot itself.
  5. The participants are strictly prohibited from using abusive or curse words. Any mention of politics, race, religion, gender, nationality, disability, inappropriate actions and signs or hateful statements will be condemned with disqualification.
  6. Judges and organizers decisions will be final and binding.
  7. Any discrepancies must be reported before or during the event. After the completion of the event none shall be addressed.
  8. No extra time will be given to the participant in the due course of performance unless there are any valid circumstances.
  9. If any props or multimedia presentations are being used, the participant must inform the event organizers a day prior to the event via email, call or a text message.
  10. The stand up act must strictly be based on the given topic.
  11. Participants are allowed to perform in English, Hindi or Konkani only.
  12. Material should be original. Plagiarized jokes or copied routines are prohibited and will be disqualified.
  13. Participants must not embarrass, harass, abuse, personally attack or pressurize the audience members. Any of this will lead to immediate disqualification.
  14. Participants must arrive at least 15 minutes before the start of the event at the designated venue.
  15. Contestants may respectfully decline to answer any question but there will be no points awarded for that particular question.
